cues.en: Instructor: What's really cool about this unsupervised learning challenge is that you get to integrate knowledge that you've acquired not only from this section,
cues.zh: 講師：這個無監督學習挑戰很棒的地方，是可以整合不只本單元，

cues.en: but also from the previous section.
cues.zh: 還包括上一單元學到的知識。

cues.en: So what you want to do here is essentially compute confidence intervals around a correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 這裡基本上要計算相關係數周圍的信賴區間。

cues.en: So in the previous section, you learned how to compute confidence intervals empirically via bootstrapping, also called resampling.
cues.zh: 上一單元學過透過拔靴法，也稱為重抽樣，以經驗方式計算信賴區間。

cues.en: And here, in this section, you've learned how to compute a correlation.
cues.zh: 這個單元則學會計算相關。

cues.en: So what I want you to do here is compute a correlation coefficient between two variables.
cues.zh: 現在希望你計算兩個變數之間的相關係數。

cues.en: It doesn't really matter if you compute a Pearson or a Spearman correlation, you can Fisher-zed transform if you like.
cues.zh: 皮爾森或史皮爾曼都可以，想做費雪 Z 轉換也可以。

cues.en: You can implement the formula to compute the correlation on your own or just use the corr function or the corrcoef function.
cues.zh: 可以自行實作相關計算公式，或直接使用 corr 或 corrcoef 函式。

cues.en: None of that matters.
cues.zh: 這些都沒有關係。

cues.en: Basically, what does matter is to generate a a data set of correlated data.
cues.zh: 真正重要的，是產生一份彼此相關的資料集。

cues.en: You also now know actually several methods to create correlated data sets.
cues.zh: 你現在其實也知道好幾種建立相關資料集的方法。

cues.en: So create a correlated data set with, let's say n equals 100 data points.
cues.zh: 因此，建立一份相關資料集，例如 N 等於 100 個資料點。

cues.en: So 100 data points in X and 100 data points in Y, and they should be correlated.
cues.zh: 也就是 X 有 100 個資料點，Y 有 100 個資料點，而且兩者相關。

cues.en: And then you compute the actual correlation coefficient, and then you are going to need to figure out how to modify the bootstrapping procedure from the previous section
cues.zh: 接著計算實際相關係數，再想辦法修改上一單元的拔靴法程序，

cues.en: in order to get 95% confidence intervals around this correlation coefficient that you compute.
cues.zh: 取得你算出的這個相關係數周圍的 95% 信賴區間。

cues.en: And if you're really into this exercise, there's all sorts of things that you can do.
cues.zh: 如果對這個練習很投入，還有各種事情可以做。

cues.en: You can try, for example, looking at the 95% confidence interval as a function of the strength of the correlation.
cues.zh: 例如把 95% 信賴區間當成相關強度的函數來探索。

cues.en: So that would be pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 這應該很有意思。

cues.en: Does the 95% confidence interval gets smaller as the correlation gets stronger?
cues.zh: 相關愈強，95% 信賴區間是否愈小？

cues.en: That seems like a pretty intuitive result that you might expect, but I don't know, maybe it doesn't work that way.
cues.zh: 這似乎是很直覺、可能預期的結果，但我也不知道，或許不是這樣。

cues.en: You can run some experiments, simulate some data, and find out on your own.
cues.zh: 可以做些實驗、模擬資料，自己找出答案。

cues.en: Anyway, there's all sorts of ways you could, all sorts of interesting directions you could take this.
cues.zh: 總之，可以朝各種有趣的方向延伸。

cues.en: But the main point of this challenge is to compute 95% confidence intervals via bootstrapping around a correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 但這個挑戰的重點，是用拔靴法計算相關係數周圍的 95% 信賴區間。
